dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a pronounced concave curvature (falcate) starting from the posterior insertion point and tapering smoothly toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point is characterized by a rounded-obtuse geometry with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a convex curve with a steep angular incline of approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the visible dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible fin exhibits a wide base relative to its height, with an approximate 1.6:1 ratio of horizontal pixel span to vertical pixel elevation.
